description.value: Upper Village Market is a locally owned, award-winning gourmet grocery store that has served Whistler's Upper Village since 1994, situated in the Hilton Grand Vacation Club building near the Fairmont and Four Seasons hotels. It stocks fresh produce, dairy, bakery goods, local artisan foods, and convenience items, and also offers online grocery ordering with hotel-room delivery. Hot coffee, fresh sandwiches, and ready-made meals to go make it a practical stop for cyclists passing through the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates all OSM contact fields (address, phone, website). The site confirms an active, full-line grocery store open year-round. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; basic groceries and hot food/coffee are explicitly confirmed by the FAQ and front page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible full-line grocery store in Whistler's Upper Village with a confirmed web presence and consistent contact details. Useful resupply stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website also mentions an in-store ATM, which may be useful context for directory visitors though it is not a listed amenity criterion.

Hot food.detail: FAQ confirms 'hot coffee and some take away foods such as fresh sandwiches, fresh pastas and meals to go'

wow_evidence: locally owned, award-winning gourmet grocery store that has served Whistler's Upper Village since 1994
